title: Full-depth gate count equals the circuit size
statement: Let $F$ be a feedforward circuit over the alphabet $\bbf_2$ with input type $\mathrm{Fin}\,n$, and suppose each of its node layers is finite. Counting the non-input nodes layer by layer through all of the layers $1,\dots,\mathrm{depth}(F)$, and accumulating these counts over the full depth of $F$, yields exactly the size of $F$, that is, its total number of non-input nodes.
hypotheses_covered: F is a feedforward circuit over the alphabet F_2 with input type Fin n
every node layer of F is finite
the running count is accumulated through all layers up to depth(F)
replaced:
For a feed-forward circuit $F$ with all node layers finite, taking $d = F.\mathrm{depth}$ gives
\[
\mathrm{gateCountBefore}\,F\,F.\mathrm{depth} \;=\; F.\mathrm{size}.
\]
